subject.title: Slack thread replies can be generated but not delivered after origin tuple is lost

question: Is the July 1 sanitized live evidence enough to sponsor a targeted implementation now, or should this stay in needs-info until a reduced Slack event sequence ties origin tuple, persisted final, absent receipt, and cleanup transition together?
rationale: The report is credible and current main only partially covers it, but the exact failing transition is still unclear enough that an automated fix would likely choose the wrong owner boundary.

options.title: Wait For Reduced Slack Sequence
options.body: Keep this open with needs-info until a QA flow or sanitized logs prove the exact origin tuple, generated final, missing receipt, and recovery/completion transition.

options.title: Sponsor Targeted Investigation Now
options.body: A maintainer can choose to investigate the durable send/recovery boundary now using the July 1 incident shape as the starting proof.

options.title: Close If No Current Repro Emerges
options.body: If maintainers decide the remaining evidence is too broad after current partial fixes, close later with a request for a fresh concrete reproduction.

recommendation.title: Wait For Reduced Slack Sequence
recommendation.body: Keep this open with needs-info until a QA flow or sanitized logs prove the exact origin tuple, generated final, missing receipt, and recovery/completion transition.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already supplied the latest maintainer triage and has adjacent Slack/session routing history for this decision.
